title: How does Pinnacle Blooms help my child with Autism cope with anxiety?
metaTitle: Managing Anxiety in Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network helps children with Autism cope with anxiety using evidence-based therapies to instill coping mechanisms and boost resilience.
html: Understanding the anxiety and distress your child with Autism may experience is at the heart of our treatment approach at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Our professionally trained therapists use evidence-based modalities like Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) to help manage anxiety. We work on building self-soothing techniques, coping strategies, and use desensitization activities to expand children's ability to tolerate different stimuli. Our ultimate goal is to empower your child to navigate through the challenges and bolster their resilience.
